prompt.zh-TW: 綠茵運動用品把帳上全部存貨（成本 {{money:e1.costOfAllInventory}}）以 {{money:e1.price}} 賒銷給一家學校，貨款下個月收。請寫出這筆賒銷的完整分錄：收入與成本都要記。
prompt.en: Greenfield Sports sells all the inventory on its books (cost {{money:e1.costOfAllInventory}}) to a school on credit for {{money:e1.price}}, to be collected next month. Write the complete entry for this credit sale, recording both the revenue and the cost.

explanation.zh-TW: 賒銷有兩組分錄。收入那一組：借記應收帳款 {{money:e1.price}}、貸記營業收入 {{money:e1.price}}，因為錢還沒收到。成本那一組：借記營業成本 {{money:e1.costOfAllInventory}}、貸記存貨 {{money:e1.costOfAllInventory}}，因為貨已經出去了。寫成一筆複合分錄或拆成兩筆都算對；毛利 {{money:e1.grossProfit}} 就是兩者的差。
explanation.en: A credit sale has two parts. The revenue part: debit trade receivables {{money:e1.price}} and credit revenue {{money:e1.price}}, because the cash has not yet arrived. The cost part: debit cost of sales {{money:e1.costOfAllInventory}} and credit inventory {{money:e1.costOfAllInventory}}, because the goods have gone. One compound entry or two separate entries are both accepted; the gross profit of {{money:e1.grossProfit}} is the difference between them.
